errors.evidence: The machine-generated description states that the '60 % des Medianlohns der Vollzeitbeschäftigten' is in red, but it is actually represented by purple bars.
The figure shows 8.50 for 2015, but the description incorrectly states 10.59.
The value reported as 12.82 for 2025 under '60 % des Medianlohns der Vollzeitbeschäftigten' is incorrect; the figure shows 14.69.
The description does not mention the dashed area of the purple bars for the years 2024 and 2025.
The description fails to acknowledge the ordering of the bars as grouped by year, which is significant in the visual presentation of the data.
